consequence.statement: The background queue size metric or accounting is now incremented once per enqueued item instead of twice; no operator action is stated.

original.statement: A bug in the Loki background cache that incremented the background queue size twice per enqueued item is fixed.

decision.reason: [ev-d6f69b890b45] only says a Loki Background Cache bug that incremented the background queue size twice per enqueued item was fixed. It does not say anything fails, is rejected, stops being honoured or needs an operator step, so no action-eligible kind is supported. It also does not say whether the queue size is an operator-visible metric or a capacity limit, which would justify behavior-change. So "none" (informational) is the best-supported reading, but the evidence does not state it directly.
